description: This file defines a store for UI state management using Vue.js Composition API (likely with Pinia). It manages UI elements such as mobile menu, cart drawer, loading state, and notifications, providing actions to toggle, open, close, and notify within the application.

methods.name: toggleMobileMenu
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the mobile menu.

methods.name: openMobileMenu
methods.description: Sets the mobile menu to open state.

methods.name: closeMobileMenu
methods.description: Sets the mobile menu to closed state.

methods.name: toggleCartDrawer
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the cart drawer.

methods.name: openCartDrawer
methods.description: Sets the cart drawer to open state.

methods.name: closeCartDrawer
methods.description: Sets the cart drawer to closed state.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Adds a notification to the list, auto-removes after duration.

methods.name: removeNotification
methods.description: Removes a notification based on its ID.
